Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the film by equating “Der Blindgänger” with the different title “Blindgänger (2024)” and thus assigned the wrong director (Kerstin Polte) without properly disambiguating by title/year. They also prematurely inferred nationality from that misidentification, sending the workflow down the wrong path.
